headline: European and Finnish AI are in a funding boom (Mistral €3bn, Finland's NestAI and Verda), enterprise AI use is rising, and the AI Act's high-risk rules have been delayed to 2027–2028.
outlook_reason: Capital, enterprise adoption (Finland 37.8% of firms use AI) and new EU "Apply AI" calls are all growing, and the AI Act delay eases near-term compliance costs. Defence and physical AI are the strongest areas.

signals.title: AI Act Digital Omnibus in force
signals.detail: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 postpones high-risk obligations: Annex III systems to 2027-12-02 and Annex I embedded systems to 2028-08-02. GPAI and transparency rules are unchanged. Date and regulation number come from a single secondary source (Cloud Security Alliance note); verify against EUR-Lex.

signals.title: Finland H1 2026 tech funding review
signals.detail: About €1.3bn across 53 deals, with space dominant. AI infrastructure Verda ($117m), Qutwo (€25m) and Capalo AI (€11m) were the main AI-related rounds.

signals.title: Mistral AI raises €3bn Series D
signals.detail: Reported as Europe's largest AI round, at a valuation above €21bn. The month comes from a September report, so the exact date is approximate.

signals.title: European Q3 VC rebound
signals.detail: €13.7bn raised across 1,300+ rounds, the best quarter since Q2 2024, led by growth rounds. The date is the quarter end.

signals.title: Horizon Europe 'Apply AI' calls open
signals.detail: Calls on AI-driven robotics, frontier AI, federated AI and data-centre efficiency open on this date, with deadlines on 2027-03-18.

signals.title: NestAI €100m round (Tesi, Nokia) for defence physical AI
signals.detail: Older than 30 days, kept as background on the Finnish defence-AI trend. The date is approximate.
